note: THE BURNTICKER CATEGORY TAXONOMY (2026-10-10). Browse is venue-agnostic: each category lists SOURCES from every adapter kind that maps to it — first-party feeds from config/burnticker/sources.json (matched by source id, the part before ':' for parameterised feeds), Polymarket tags (Gamma tag slugs, open events), and Kalshi categories (only while BURNTICKER_KALSHI_ENABLED is not 0). The page reads the same whether a venue is on or off; a category with no source on this host says so. Order here is the order on the page. usgs.quakes6 is deliberately unmapped (disaster-adjacent, not launchable until the owner confirms). `native` lists the first-party sources with their own code (sources/native.ts): espn:<league> team results (the Team coin picker) and nws:<metric> climate rules (a station + threshold form). `guided: elections` opens the race-type → state → race → outcome flow. `adjudicatedOnly` marks a category with no qualifying first-party source: only adjudicated markets (Polymarket) are listed, and the page says so rather than inventing a source.
